title: Official source confirmation: IRS SOI migration files, Title Guaranty Buyer Statistics and Freddie Mac PMMS

irs.publisher: Internal Revenue Service, Statistics of Income (SOI) Division

title_guaranty.publisher: Title Guaranty of Hawaii, LLC (company site; publisher of the counts, so marked company-published, not government)
title_guaranty.posting_dates_from: https://www.tghawaii.com/wp-json/wp/v2/media?search=Buyer-Stats (public WordPress media listing: upload date in site time, HST, and in GMT)

freddie_mac.publisher: Freddie Mac, Primary Mortgage Market Survey (PMMS)
freddie_mac.edition: Weekly release of 2026-10-08 (page reads "U.S. weekly mortgage rate averages as of 10/08/2026"); history files last-modified Thu, 08 Oct 2026 13:37 GMT

method: IRS: listed every migration file the report scripts read (an/irs_20yr.py, an/irs_decade.py, research/buyer-origins/irs_states.py and irs_instate.py; local folders irs2/, irsdec/, irsout/, irsold/) and the hashes in research/buyer-origins/irs_sha256.txt and irs_outflow_sha256.txt.

IRS: took each file URL from the official year pages (soi-tax-stats-migration-data-YYYY-YYYY) or, for 2004–05 to 2010–11, from the county ZIP links on the migration index page, then downloaded every file again from irs.gov on 2026-10-09 with curl (no redirects) and computed sha256.

IRS 2004–05 to 2010–11: IRS publishes these county years only as ZIPs of per-state workbooks (countyYYYY.zip). Downloaded the 7 ZIPs, extracted only the named Hawaii members, and hashed them. Direct URLs for the members return 404 except co1011ihi.xls and co1011ohi.xls.
IRS: compared each fresh hash with the hash the report recorded (CSV files) and with the report's local copy (all files). Where bytes differed, compared every cell with xlrd.

IRS: re-derived two published figures from the fresh files (2022–23 different-state totals for the four counties; Hawaii net households lost to Washington and Nevada, 2011–12 to 2022–23) as a content check.
IRS schedule: read the 2026 full calendar year public release list (soi-public-release-list.xlsx) and the Upcoming Data Releases page; HEAD-probed the 2023–24 file and page URLs.

Title Guaranty: extracted every Title Guaranty Buyer Statistics citation in hawaii-buyer-origins.src.html (links and edition names in citation text), expanded group citations (for example "Q4 editions 2015–2025 (Maui and Hawaii Island PDFs)") into individual PDFs, HEAD-requested all 140 Buyer-Stats links on tghawaii.com/market/, read posting dates from the site's public WordPress media listing, re-downloaded the 23 core PDFs (all linked PDFs plus every Q4 2024, Q2 2025, Q4 2025, Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 island edition) and compared sha256 with the report's copies; read PDF metadata with pdfinfo.

Title Guaranty Q3 2026: checked the market page (unchanged byte-for-byte since 2026-10-08), the homepage, the media listing for every upload since 2026-08-30, and HEAD-probed 16 plausible Q3 2026 file names.
Freddie Mac: downloaded the PMMS page and both history files; read the 30-year fixed column; checked the two files agree for every 2026 week.
notes: Aggregates only. No owner names, street addresses, parcel IDs or TMKs appear here. The Title Guaranty media listing in raw/ also contains unrelated marketing flyers; only Buyer-Stats entries are reported.

Fewer-than-20 flag: no cell in this file is a count of fewer than 20 units. The IRS county totals shown (2022–23) range from 940 to 20,909 returns. IRS itself suppresses county-to-county pairs under 20 returns.

IRS Last-Modified headers are not publication dates: many files show a blanket 2025-11-07 date or 1970-01-01 from the IRS web host. Only the 2022–23 files (2026-03-19) line up with a scheduled release.
Title Guaranty posting dates are the WordPress upload times, in site time (HST) and GMT. The Q4 2025 PDFs went up 2026-02-12 14:24 HST, which is 2026-02-13 00:24 UTC. Both dates appear in the report.

Title Guaranty edition names follow the files: "Qn YYYY" is year to date through the end of that quarter (Q1 = Jan–Mar, Q2 = Jan–Jun, Q3 = Jan–Sep, Q4 = Jan–Dec), as printed on page 1 of each PDF. The Q2 2026 Hawaiʻi Island file is named Buyer-Stats-Hawaii-Island-Q2-2026.pdf; Buyer-Stats-Hawaii-Q2-2026.pdf does not exist (301 to homepage).

Title Guaranty also posts combined all-island PDFs (for example Buyer-Stats-Q2-2026.pdf, 15,675,541 bytes, posted 2026-08-31 12:32 HST). They are not linked on the market page and the report does not use them.
The market page links Buyer-Stats-Hawaii-Q1-2025.pdf, but that URL redirects (301) to the homepage. The report does not cite that edition.

PMMS: the report text already uses the 2026-10-08 reading (7.40%). The monthly chart (page_data mortgage series) still shows October 2026 as the single 2026-10-01 reading (7.28%); with both October weeks the month-to-date average is 7.34%. The Jul, Aug and Sep 2026 monthly values (6.54, 6.67, 6.86) match the weekly file.

PMMS checks of report text, all confirmed: 6.05% February 2026 average (6.0475), 7 straight weekly increases to 2026-10-08, first week below 6% since 2022-09-08 on 2026-02-26, H1 2026 average 6.27% against H1 2025 6.80% (these reproduce as the mean of monthly averages, 6.265 and 6.802; a plain mean of weekly readings gives 6.27% and 6.81%), 7.79% October 2023 peak (2023-10-26), and a 14.9% payment rise from 6.05% to 7.40%.
gaps: IRS does not publish sha256 or checksums. "Match" means the file served on 2026-10-09 is byte-identical to the report's copy, not that IRS certifies either one.
The report kept no recorded hashes for the 14 early-year Hawaii county workbooks or the 12 Hawaii state workbooks. Those were compared against the local copies in irsold/ that the scripts read.

IRS 2023–24 migration data is not out yet: countyinflow2324.csv, countyoutflow2324.csv, 2324hi.xlsx and the 2023-2024 page all returned 404 on 2026-10-09. The release list schedules it for 2026-11-20, and IRS calls release dates tentative.

Title Guaranty: Q4 2015–Q4 2018 server copies were re-uploaded on 2020-01-24, so the site does not show their original posting dates. PDF creation dates (2016-02-04, 2017-02-14, 2018-01-31, 2019-03-15/16) are shown instead.

Title Guaranty: 31 historical editions the report cites (Q4 2015–Q4 2023 Maui and Hawaiʻi Island, Q1–Q3 2024 for all islands, Oahu Q4 2019, Maui Q1 2024, Oahu Q1 2025) were not downloaded again. For these, the server Content-Length equals the size of the report's copy and the posting date comes from the media listing.
Title Guaranty does not publish its method or a release calendar, so no expected date for Q3 2026 can be given. Past Q3 editions went up 2023-12-13, 2025-01-09 and 2025-11-24 (HST).
The "Q1–Q3 2024 editions" citation does not name islands. Four islands are assumed, matching the report's working copies in ca_tg24/.
No host blocked access. irs.gov, tghawaii.com and freddiemac.com all served plain HTTPS without bot checks.
